title: RBI Penalty Order on IndusInd Bank, Fusion Finance, Northern Arc Capital, Muthoot MCred
description: <cite index="16-1,16-3,16-4">The RBI imposed a Rs 59.20 lakh penalty on IndusInd Bank for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions on deposit rates and securitisation of standard assets. The regulator found that the bank had paid interest on deposits held in certain current accounts and had undertaken activities in the nature of 'synthetic securitisation'.</cite> <cite index="16-5,16-6,16-7">Fusion Finance was penalised Rs 2.7 lakh, Northern Arc Capital Rs 6.2 lakh, and Muthoot MCred Rs 3.1 lakh for regulatory violations. Muthoot MCred was fined for non-compliance with RBI directions on asset classification, having upgraded certain loan accounts classified as non-performing assets (NPAs) to 'standard' without repayment of entire arrears.</cite>
